capabilities: Edit HTML note properties with native property controls
Add, rename, and delete properties within a single HTML file
Store metadata as a non-executing JSON block inside each HTML file
Include HTML and HTM properties in the vault-wide property catalog and occurrence counts
Refresh the catalog after file changes, moves, deletions, or excluded-file rule changes
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not touch Markdown frontmatter; it stores a JSON metadata block inside HTML files and edits it through the native properties UI.
extras: Preview release; loads only on Obsidian desktop 1.14.4 because it uses non-public APIs. Command and file-menu labels are currently in Chinese while the README is bilingual. The README states it is a vibe-coded project with an AI-assisted verification record, and notes that HTML rendering, search, graph links, Bases, backlinks, and the tag sidebar are out of scope.
intentEvidence: Edit properties of HTML notes using Obsidian's native Properties interface, and include HTML properties in the vault-wide property catalog
problem: Obsidian's native Properties and vault-wide property catalog only cover Markdown notes, so HTML notes in a vault have no property editing or catalog presence.
summary: Lets users edit HTML note metadata with Obsidian's native Properties interface and include HTML properties in the vault-wide property catalog.
